summary: AI productivity and workspace tools have reached mainstream enterprise adoption in 2026, with generative AI embedded directly into the platforms where knowledge workers already operate — email, documents, meetings, and search. The market has bifurcated into general-purpose assistants with massive user bases (ChatGPT, Google Gemini) and specialized workflow tools targeting specific jobs like meeting capture, writing, and enterprise search. Adoption is accelerating rapidly, with the 2026 Stanford AI Index confirming that AI integration into business workflows is now a defining feature of competitive organizations.

tools.name: ChatGPT
capabilities: Long-form writing and editing
Research summarization and synthesis
Document analysis and Q&A
Data analysis with code interpreter
Image generation and analysis
Custom GPTs for specialized workflows
Voice mode for hands-free interaction
Web search with cited sources
Project and memory management across sessions
tools.best_for: All-around AI assistant for writing, research, analysis, and business workflows across any industry

tools.name: Google Gemini (Workspace AI)
